subject: TOURN: submission rate limit has TWO independent bypasses
description: MEDIUM. The 10s limit is scoped to team+challenge. (1) Rotate challenges: one user pushed 12 guesses across 12 challenges in 922ms against PRODUCTION, ~13/s unbounded. (2) Check-then-act race, Mallory/emulator: 5 teammates submitting the same challenge simultaneously all 5 accepted, limit held for zero of five. Together the anti-guessing throttle is decorative. Interacts with the weak-flag finding: online guessing becomes viable. Fix: make the limit per-user and serialize it.
